summary: The Stone Halls are the ancient foundation of the Plane of Earth. Massive corridors, echoing chambers, and tectonic archways form the oldest structures of elemental stone.
history: Carved during the earliest compression of primordial stone.
Echo chambers formed naturally as resonance accumulated over millennia.
Mountainheart pillars were shaped by tectonic force from the plane’s core.
The Hall Guardian arose as the protector of the ancient stone corridors.
